'''Pepper soup''' is a popular Nigerian [[Cookbook:Soup|soup.]] It is usually very spicy and is served as an appetizer in both official and informal gatherings. 

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] [[Cookbook:Goat|goat]], [[Cookbook:Catfish|catfish]], [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], or assorted [[Cookbook:Meat|meats]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] (adjust to taste) 
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|seasoning cubes]]
* 1 tbsp fresh grated [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] or [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] (optional) 
* 4–6 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] water 
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] pepper soup spice mix
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|ground crayfish]]
* 1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:pepper|pepper]] (adjust to taste)
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Scent Leaf|scent leaves]] or [[Cookbook:Ashanti Pepper|uziza]] leaves

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Stock Pot|Cooking pot]]
* [[Cookbook: Cooking Spoon|Stirring spoon]]
* Kitchen [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|Cutting board]]
* [[Cookbook: Mixing Bowl|Bowls]]

== Procedure ==
#Wash and cut the meat into bite-sized pieces.
#Rub the meat well with the salt, seasoning cube, and ginger/garlic.
#Combine the meat and water in a pot, and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until tender.
#Stir in the pepper soup spice mix, ground crayfish, and ground pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes to let the flavors blend.
#Stir in the scent leaves, and cook for 2–3 minutes.
#Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve hot.
